member.name: M:EsemkaLibrary.Controllers.G02SignUpController.EmailRegex
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^([\\w\\.\\-]+)@([\\w\\-]+)((\\.(\\w){2,3})+)$
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ 1st capture group.
○ Match a character in the set [-.\w] atomically at least once.
○ Match '@'.
○ 2nd capture group.
○ Match a character in the set [-\w] atomically at least once.
○ 3rd capture group.
○ Loop greedily at least once.
○ 4th capture group.
○ Match '.'.
○ Loop greedily at least 2 and at most 3 times.
○ 5th capture group.
○ Match a word character.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.

member.name: M:EsemkaLibrary.Controllers.G02SignUpController.PasswordRegex
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*\\d).{8,}$
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Zero-width positive lookahead.
○ Match a character other than '\n' greedily any number of times.
○ Match a character in the set [a-z].
○ Zero-width positive lookahead.
○ Match a character other than '\n' greedily any number of times.
○ Match a character in the set [A-Z].
○ Zero-width positive lookahead.
○ Match a character other than '\n' greedily any number of times.
○ Match a Unicode digit.
○ Match a character other than '\n' greedily at least 8 times.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.
